title: Getting Art to the People via the Web
main_content:
For many artists, it is a lack of exposure rather than a lack of talent that keeps the public from seeing their work.

To rectify the situation, MOV!, an organization dedicated to promoting art, is using Facebook to try and get some aspiring artists the exposure that could make their career.

questions.question: Why are many artists unable to get their work seen by the public?
options: Because they have no interest in sharing their work
Because art organizations refuse to promote them

questions.question: What is MOV! using to promote aspiring artists?
What is MOV!'s goal in promoting these artists on Facebook?
options: To give them the exposure that could help their careers
To sell their artwork to art critics
To organize a contest for the best painting
questions.answer: To give them the exposure that could help their careers
